XData.name: PageContents
XData.Description: This XML defines the contents of this page.
XData.Data:
<pane xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" width="100%" title="Edit Sql"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInFieldSet" legend=" To export / import Filter logic table " width="100%"> <label id="labelEnv" hidden="true"/>
<spacer height="10"/> <label value="SchemaName: IHC_ITF_Process_Table" id="schemaNm" /> <spacer height="10"/> <text label="Table Name: " id="tableNm" name="Table" required="true" size="50" /> <text label="Namespace:" id="Namespace" name="Namespace" size="25"/>
<spacer height="20"/>
<vgroup> <text label="CheckIn Comment:" id="CheckInComment" name="CheckInComment" size="50"/> <spacer height="10"/>
</vgroup>
<spacer height="10"/>
<hgroup> <button id="butExport" caption="Export" onclick="zenPage.exportTable();" title="Export data from the table to a file and check-in to SubVersion" width="35"/> <spacer width="20"/>
<button id="butImport" caption="Import" onclick="zenPage.importFile();" title="Get SubVersion file and Import the data in the table" /> <spacer width="20"/>
<button id="butLog" caption="Log" onclick="zenPage.logFile();" title="Get SubVersion history" /> <spacer width="20"/>
<button id="butView" caption="View" onclick="zenPage.viewFile();" title="View the file" />
</hgroup>
<spacer height="20"/> <label id="lblAccess" value="" />
</fieldSet>
</pane>
